units.title: Accounting Standards and Ind AS
units.topics: AS-2: Valuation of Inventories, AS-9: Revenue Recognition, AS-10: Property, Plant and Equipment, Introduction to Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS): Convergence with IFRS, Salient Features and Major Differences between AS and Ind AS.

units.title: Insurance Claims
units.topics: Claim for Loss of Stock: Meaning, Calculation of Fire Insurance Claim under Average Clause, Gross Profit Ratio, Memoranda Trading Account, Claim for Loss of Profit (Consequential Loss): Meaning, Terms used (Indemnity Period, Standing Charges, Standard Turnover), Calculation of Claim.

units.title: Valuation of Goodwill
units.topics: Meaning, Definition and Factors affecting Goodwill, Need for Valuation of Goodwill, Methods of Valuation: Average Profit Method (Simple and Weighted), Super Profit Method, Capitalization Method (Capitalization of Average Profit and Capitalization of Super Profit), Annuity Method.

units.title: Accounting for Investments
units.topics: Meaning and Types of Securities: Fixed Income Bearing Securities and Variable Income Bearing Securities, Cum-interest and Ex-interest Purchase and Sale, Accounting Treatment as per AS-13 (Accounting for Investments), Preparation of Investment Accounts with Ledger Postings.

subjects.title: Inventory, Labour, and Overhead Accounting - II

units.title: Inventory Control
units.topics: Meaning and Objectives of Inventory Control, Techniques of Inventory Control: Stock Levels (Minimum, Maximum, Re-order, Danger Level), Economic Order Quantity (EOQ), ABC Analysis, VED Analysis, Perpetual Inventory System, Just-In-Time (JIT) Inventory.

units.title: Labour Cost
units.topics: Meaning and Classification of Labour Cost, Time Keeping and Time Booking: Methods and Significance, Idle Time and Overtime: Causes and Treatment, Labour Turnover: Causes, Effects and Measurement (Separation, Replacement, Flux Method), Incentive Wage Plans: Halsey, Rowan, Taylor and Merrick Differential Piece Rate Systems.

units.title: Overheads Accounting-I
units.topics: Meaning, Definition and Classification of Overheads (by function, element and behaviour), Allocation and Apportionment of Overheads: Primary Distribution Summary, Re-apportionment of Service Department Overheads: Secondary Distribution (Direct, Step-ladder, Repeated Distribution, Simultaneous Equation Method).

units.title: Overhead Accounting-II
units.topics: Absorption of Overheads: Meaning and Methods (Direct Material Cost, Direct Labour Cost, Labour Hours, Machine Hour Rate), Computation of Machine Hour Rate, Under-absorption and Over-absorption of Overheads: Meaning, Causes and Accounting Treatment, Activity-Based Costing (ABC): Basic Concepts.

subjects.title: Principles and Functions of Management - II

units.title: Nature and Evolution of Management
units.topics: Meaning, Definition, Nature, Process and Significance of Management, Management as Science, Art and Profession, Evolution of Management Thought: Classical School (Taylor, Fayol), Neo-Classical School (Mayo, Behavioural Sciences), Modern Systems and Contingency Approaches.

units.title: Understanding Management: Planning and Decision Making
units.topics: Planning: Meaning, Nature, Importance, Types of Plans, Steps in Planning Process, Objectives, Policies, Procedures and Methods, Management by Objectives (MBO): Process and Benefits, Decision Making: Meaning, Process, Types of Decisions, Rational Decision Making.

units.title: Management at Work: The process of organizing and staffing
units.topics: Organizing: Meaning, Principles and Process, Formal and Informal Organization, Organizational Structure: Line, Staff, Functional, Matrix, Concept of Authority and Responsibility, Delegation of Authority, Difficulties in Delegation, Decentralization, Staffing: Need, Importance, Recruitment: Sources and Methods.

units.title: Result orientation: Motivation Direction and Team Work
units.topics: Motivation: Meaning, Importance, Nature, Principles, Theories (Maslow, Herzberg, McGregor), Controlling: Meaning, Need, Process, Techniques, Direction: Meaning, Elements, Principles, Techniques, Team Work, Group Dynamics, Principles of interpersonal communication and Group Behaviour.

units.title: Introduction
units.topics: Product: Meaning, Definition, Levels of Product, Product Classification, Product Life Cycle (PLC): Stages and Marketing Strategies, New Product Development Process, Branding, Packaging and Labelling: Concepts and Importance.

units.title: Process of Selling
units.topics: Pricing: Meaning, Factors Influencing Pricing Decisions, Pricing Methods and Strategies (Cost-based, Market-based, Value-based, Penetration, Skimming), Personal Selling Process: Prospecting, Preparation, Presentation, Demonstration, Objection Handling, Closing and Follow-up.

units.title: Rural Marketing
units.topics: Meaning, Features and Significance of Rural Marketing in India, Rural Consumer Behaviour: Characteristics and Influencing Factors, Challenges in Rural Marketing, Strategies for Effective Rural Marketing, Rural Retail and Distribution Models.

units.title: Marketing Environment
units.topics: Macro and Micro Marketing Environment, Consumer Protection and Ethics in Marketing: Consumer Protection Act 2019 overview, Rights of Consumers, Social Responsibility of Marketers, Green Marketing and Sustainable Practices.

units.title: Recent Trends in Marketing
units.topics: Digital Marketing, Social Media Marketing, Content Marketing, Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Influencer Marketing, Artificial Intelligence in Marketing, Direct Marketing and Event Marketing.

subjects.title: History, Principles and Management of Cooperation - II

units.title: Co-operation
units.topics: Meaning, Definition, Nature and Scope of Co-operation, Principles of Co-operation: Rochdale Principles, Reformulated ICA Principles (1995), Values of Co-operation, Role of Co-operation in Economic and Social Development.

units.title: History of Cooperative Movement in India
units.topics: Evolution and Growth of Co-operative Movement in India: Pre-Independence Period (Acts of 1904, 1912) and Post-Independence Period, Five Year Plans and Co-operatives, Committees on Cooperation (Gorwala Committee, Mirdha Committee, Vaidyanathan Committee), Ministry of Cooperation at the Centre.

units.title: Types of Cooperatives Societies
units.topics: Structure and Functioning of Co-operative Societies: Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS), District Central Co-operative Banks (DCCB), State Co-operative Banks (SCB), Urban Co-operative Banks (UCB), Consumer Co-operatives, Housing Co-operatives, Dairy Co-operatives, Sugar Co-operatives in Maharashtra.

units.title: Co-operative Education and Training
units.topics: Need and Importance of Co-operative Education and Training, Institutional Infrastructure: National Council for Cooperative Training (NCCT), VAMNICOM, State and District Co-operative Unions, Leadership and Management Challenges in Co-operatives.

units.title: Basic Concepts of Insurance
units.topics: Meaning, Definition, Nature and Significance of Insurance, Fundamental Principles of Insurance: Utmost Good Faith (Uberrima Fides), Insurable Interest, Indemnity, Subrogation, Contribution, Proximate Cause, Mitigation of Loss, History and Development of Insurance in India, Role of IRDAI.

units.title: Types of Insurance
units.topics: Life Insurance: Meaning, Nature, Types of Life Policies (Term, Whole Life, Endowment, Money Back, ULIPs), General Insurance: Fire Insurance, Marine Insurance (Hull, Cargo, Freight), Motor Insurance, Health Insurance, Liability Insurance.

units.title: Risk Management in Insurance Sector
units.topics: Concept of Risk: Pure vs. Speculative Risk, Risk Identification, Assessment and Measurement, Methods of Handling Risk (Avoidance, Retention, Sharing, Transfer, Loss Prevention), Underwriting: Meaning, Principles and Process, Claim Settlement Process in Life and General Insurance.

units.title: Emerging Trends and Innovations in Insurance
units.topics: InsurTech: Concept and Applications, AI, IoT and Telematics in Insurance, Micro-insurance and Rural Insurance, Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY), Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY), Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY), Digital Distribution and Online Insurance Portals.

subjects.title: Start up and Insurance Law - II

units.title: Business Structure and Registration of Startup
units.topics: Choosing Legal Structure for Startups: Sole Proprietorship, Partnership, LLP, Private Limited Company, One Person Company (OPC), DPIIT Recognition Process and Criteria, Startup India Scheme, Tax Exemption under Section 80-IAC, Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) Protection for Startups: Patents, Trademarks, Copyrights, Trade Secrets.

units.title: Laws relating to Startups
units.topics: Key Legal Compliances for Startups: Corporate Law compliances, Employment and Labour Law compliances (PF, ESI, Minimum Wages), Contractual Framework (Founders Agreement, Non-Disclosure Agreement, Employment Contracts), Funding Agreements: Term Sheet, Share Subscription Agreement (SSA), Shareholders Agreement (SHA).

units.title: Insurance Sector in India
units.topics: Regulatory Architecture of Insurance Sector: Insurance Act 1938, Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority Act 1999 (IRDAI), Role, Powers and Functions of IRDAI, Protection of Policyholders' Interests Regulations, Ombudsman Scheme for Insurance Grievances.

units.title: Laws relating to the insurance: fundamentals and significance
units.topics: Legal Principles of Insurance Contracts, Life Insurance Corporation Act 1956, General Insurance Business (Nationalisation) Act 1972, Marine Insurance Act 1963, Motor Vehicles Act 1988 provisions related to Third Party Insurance, Rights, Duties and Liabilities of Insurer and Insured.

units.title: Techniques of Counting
units.topics: Fundamental Principles of Counting: Addition and Multiplication Rules, Permutations and Combinations: Formulas and Properties, Partitions and Distributions, Applications to Probability Problems.

units.title: Random Variables
units.topics: Concept of Random Variable, Discrete and Continuous Random Variables, Probability Mass Function (pmf) and Probability Density Function (pdf), Cumulative Distribution Function (cdf), Mathematical Expectation and Variance: Properties and Computation.

units.title: Some Standard Discrete Probability Distributions
units.topics: Binomial Distribution: pmf, mean, variance, properties and applications, Poisson Distribution: pmf, mean, variance, additive property, Poisson approximation to Binomial, Applications in business and queueing.

units.title: Normal Distribution
units.topics: Normal Distribution: pdf, properties of normal curve, standard normal distribution (Z-distribution), Computation of probabilities using normal table, Applications of normal distribution in quality control and business forecasting.

units.title: Payment Systems Architecture and Infrastructure
units.topics: National and International Payment Infrastructure: NPCI, SWIFT, Fedwire, Payment Gateways and Payment Aggregators: Architecture, Integration and Workflow, Tokenization and Card On File (CoF) Tokenization, Settlement Mechanisms: Gross Settlement vs Net Settlement, Clearing House Operations.

units.title: Card Technologies and Payment Networks
units.topics: Credit Cards, Debit Cards, Prepaid Cards: Architecture and Lifecycle, Magnetic Stripe, EMV Chip and Contactless (NFC) Payments, Card Networks (Visa, MasterCard, RuPay), Point of Sale (POS) Terminals, mPOS, SoftPOS and QR-based Payment Solutions.

units.title: FinTech Applications - Lending, Insurance and Wealth
units.topics: Peer-to-Peer (P2P) Lending and Crowdfunding, Digital Lending: Alternative Credit Scoring, Underwriting Algorithms, Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL), InsurTech and WealthTech Platforms: Robo-Advisory, Automated Micro-investing, Algorithmic Wealth Management.

units.title: APIs, Open Banking and Risk Management in FinTech
units.topics: Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) in Banking, Account Aggregator Framework in India, Open Banking Architecture, Risk Management: Fraud Detection, Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Cyber Risk, Regulatory Sandboxes and Compliance Automation (RegTech).

units.title: Market Structure
units.topics: Concept and Classification of Market Structures, Perfect Competition: Meaning, Features, Price and Output Determination in Short Run and Long Run, Equilibrium of the Firm and Industry.

units.title: Imperfect Market Structures
units.topics: Monopoly: Meaning, Features, Price and Output Determination, Price Discrimination: Degrees and Conditions, Monopolistic Competition: Features, Product Differentiation, Selling Costs, Excess Capacity, Oligopoly: Features, Kinked Demand Curve Model, Collusive and Non-collusive Oligopoly.

units.title: Government Intervention and Welfare Concepts
units.topics: Role of Government in Regulating Markets, Price Controls: Price Ceilings and Price Floors, Market Failure: Causes (Externalities, Public Goods, Asymmetric Information), Concepts of Social Welfare, Pareto Optimality: Meaning and Conditions.

units.title: Measures to improve Welfare
units.topics: Welfare Economics: Pigovian Welfare Economics, Compensation Principles (Kaldor-Hicks), Public Policy Interventions to Correct Market Failures: Taxes, Subsidies, Regulations, Social Security and Inclusive Growth Measures.

units.title: Final Accounts of Co-Operative Societies
units.topics: Meaning and Features of Co-operative Societies, Legal Provisions regarding Accounting and Audit under Maharashtra State Co-operative Societies Act 1960, Preparation of Profit and Loss Account and Balance Sheet of Primary Credit Co-operative Societies / Consumer Stores.

units.title: Branch Accounts
units.topics: Meaning, Need and Objectives of Branch Accounting, Types of Branches: Dependent Branches and Independent Branches, Accounting for Dependent Branches: Debtors System and Stock & Debtors System (at Cost Price and at Invoice Price), Wholesale Branch Accounting.

subjects.title: Constitutional Values, Fundamental Duties and Political System in India

units.title: Introduction to Constitution of India and Constitutional Values
units.topics: Historical Background and Philosophy of Indian Constitution, Preamble to the Constitution, Core Constitutional Values: Justice (Social, Economic, Political), Liberty (Thought, Expression, Belief, Faith, Worship), Equality (Status and Opportunity), Fraternity, Dignity, Unity and Integrity.

units.title: Political System in India and Fundamental Duties
units.topics: Political System in India: Union Legislature (Structure, Powers, Role), Union Executive (President, Vice President, Prime Minister, Council of Ministers), State Legislature and State Executive (Governor, Chief Minister, Council of Ministers), Election Commission of India and Election Reforms, Fundamental Duties (Article 51A): Significance and Civic Responsibilities.
